config.description: Bearer token — your Nova Oneda API key (starts with nv_live_). No account yet? Sign up free at https://oneda.freeelatech.com/oneda.html — new accounts get 50 free AI-assisted memory calls, no separate Claude API key needed to start. Grab a key from the API Keys page, or run `nova-oneda setup --key <key>` to configure it automatically.
